_metadata.description: Single authoritative metrics file for the Cognitive Adaptive AI Tutor capstone paper.

preference.note: Per-rater win rates inconsistent (Rater1=100%, Rater2=50%). Report qualitatively only.

inter_rater_reliability.reconstruction_note: Individual rater files deleted after original run. Kappa computed from minimum-disagreement integer scores reconstructed from 2-rater means stored in blind_rating_results.json.
inter_rater_reliability.flagged_note: No pairs flagged at threshold=2 under min-disagreement reconstruction.

learning_outcomes.note: n=2, preliminary. USER-71cbf510 posttest manually set to 1.0 (6/6 correct, API not captured due to session interruption).

ablation.latency_note: Confounded by embedding cache. Randomised rerun recommended.

latency.primary_speed_claim: Full system is 2.96x faster than baseline by median latency (9.8975s vs 29.2823s). Excluding 2 outlier(s): 2.8x.

user_satisfaction.note: Respondents are development team members. External user study required.

limitations.title: Inter-Rater Reliability
limitations.text: Inter-rater reliability was low (Pearson r=-0.0467). Quadratic-weighted Cohen kappa by dimension (min-disagreement reconstruction): correctness=0.727 (substantial), pedagogical_clarity=0.222 (fair), appropriateness=0.200 (fair). Per-rater win rates (100%/50%) are reported separately. Rubric calibration and >= 3 raters recommended for future work.

limitations.title: Ablation Latency Caching Artifact
limitations.text: Fixed config run order with shared embedding cache artificially deflates full_system latency. All configs show ~10-16s; ordering unreliable. Randomized rerun needed.

limitations.title: Ablation Primary Metric Alignment
limitations.text: Scaffolding accuracy (originally reported) is identical across all configs since the Decision Engine is untouched. Corrected per-component metrics derived from existing data.

limitations.title: Underpowered Learning Outcome Study
limitations.text: Learning gain measurement: n=1 (KHIZ-001), pretest=82%, posttest=79%, raw gain=-0.03, Hake normalised gain=-0.1667. Insufficient to draw conclusions about learning effectiveness.

limitations.title: Baseline Latency Non-Normality
limitations.text: Baseline std (74.5937s) > mean (65.6098s). 2 outlier run(s) above 100s. Median reported as primary speed metric.
